verdict.rationale: GitLab Duo Chat works inside the product with access to the project's issues, merge requests, commits, and CI/CD pipelines, keeps context across conversations, and answers queries such as finding a relevant merge request. First-party agents also review code, remediate vulnerabilities, and handle research tasks, which yields AI suggestions grounded in the user's own data. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of proactive AI-generated insight summaries or analytics over project data, detailed docs on what suggestions are surfaced, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
